# Comparison Matrix

Component ID: comparison-matrix

## Purpose and selection

- Compare exactly two options using 1–4 common criteria.

Do not use:

- Do not compare more than two options, incompatible units or omit unfavorable evidence to force a winner.

## Supported inputs

- title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- options: Exactly two nonempty option names separated by |; apply the same criterion and unit to both.
- rows: Supply 1–4 entries separated by ";", each with exactly 3 nonempty fields separated by "|". Keep each field within 64 characters.
- winner: Choose only a declared option; do not force a winner without evidence.

Capacity contract:

~~~json
{
  "variable": "rows",
  "separator": ";",
  "maxItems": 4,
  "minItems": 1,
  "fieldSeparator": "|",
  "fieldsPerItem": 3,
  "maxFieldLength": 64
}
~~~

## Reading order and motion

- Identify both options
- Compare one common criterion at a time
- Read the full matrix

Pattern: compare. Native default duration: 10s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### step-1

- Target: .cm-row:not(.cm-head):nth-child(2)
- Visible action: Reveal and focus the next semantic item

- Authored start: 8.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
- missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
